content.title: Meet the New Cast Members Joining ‘Euphoria’ Season 3 (Including a Famous YouTuber!)
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Euphoria season 3, which premieres on April 12, will feature a five-year time jump, with Rue in Mexico trying to pay off her debtsNew cast members include Sharon Stone, Rosalía, Natasha Lyonne, Marshawn Lynch and YouTuber Trisha PaytasLexi (Maude Apatow) will be working with Sharon Stone’s character in Hollywood A slew of new cast members are joining the twisted world of Euphoria. Season 3, which premieres on April 12, is welcoming several new stars. Those include Orange is the New Black alum Natasha Lyonne, The Bear’s Danielle Deadwyler, Grammy Award winner Rosalía and former NFL player Marshawn Lynch. The final chapter of Euphoria will see the characters five years after high school. Rue (Zendaya) works as a drug mule for Laurie (Martha Kelly), meanwhile, Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Nate (Jacob Elordi) are married and Jules (Hunter Schafer) is a sugar baby. While the character details of many of the new cast members are unclear, Oscar nominee Sharon Stone is playing a showrunner whom Lexi (Maude Apatow) works for, according to creator Sam Levinson. "[Stone] is just absolutely delightful and a true icon," he said in a December 2025 HBO Max presentation, per Variety. Here’s everything to know about the new cast members who have joined Euphoria season 3. Sharon Stone Sharon Stone. Courtesy of HBO The Casino star is playing a showrunner named Patty Lance, whom Lexi works with — and she described her experience with the show as “euphoric.” “There is little more exciting than going to work with this team of thrilling talent,” Stone said in a February 2026 statement, per Variety. “From the genius of Sam Levinson to the raw sophistication of this profoundly moving cast and tight crew. I am honored to be Euphoric.” In addition to Casino, Stone has appeared in films like Basic Instinct (1992), Last Dance (1996) and Catwoman (2004). Rosalía Rosalia. Taylor Hill/FilmMagic Rosalía has joined the fan-favorite HBO series as a stripper named Magick, per IMDb and Vulture. The Grammy- winning artist expressed her excitement for joining the show in a February 2026 interview with Elle. “Euphoria is a series that has such a cultural impact,” Rosalía said. “It’s amazing. It has a lot of honesty. It has a lot of emotional richness to me.” The singer is best known for her music, but she previously starred in Pain and Glory alongside Antonio Banderas and Penélope Cruz in 2019. Natasha Lyonne Natasha Lyonne. Taylor Hill/FilmMagic Like most new cast members, Lyonne has been very quiet about her upcoming role in Euphoria season 3. Lyonne did share the new cast announcement on her Instagram in October 2025, writing, “♥️ @euphoria ♥️ Repost from @variety.” In addition to Orange is the New Black, Lyonne has starred in American Pie (1999), Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery (2022), The Fantastic Four: First Steps (2025) and more. Danielle Deadwyler Danielle Deadwyler. Neilson Barnard/Getty When asked about her upcoming role in Euphoria season 3, Danielle Deadwyler simply said that this season has "everything." During a March 2026 interview with InStyle, the actress said, “I mean, they’re giving y'all everything. They give you enough to pique your interest.” Like Lyonne, Deadwyler’s character is yet to be revealed. She has previously appeared in The Bear, Till (2022), Station Eleven and more. Asante Blackk Asante Blackk. Matt Winkelmeyer/Getty In addition to Rosalía and Stone, Asante Blackk is the only other new Euphoria cast member whose character name has been shared. According to Deadline, his role of Kidd will portray a young man caught up in a high-pressure drug operation. “Blackk will play Kidd, a runner for a ruthless kingpin played by new series regular Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje,” Deadline revealed in March 2025. Blackk is best known for his roles on This Is Us and When They See Us. Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje. Courtesy of HBO Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje will be playing the leader of a drug operation in Euphoria season 3, per Deadline. The actor shared his reaction on joining the production in February 2025, writing on Instagram, “Very excited to be joining the cast of #EuphoriaS3! @euphoria @hbo 🎬 🖤.” Akinnuoye-Agbaje has starred in Lost, Oz, The Mummy Returns (2001), The Bourne Identity (2002), Suicide Squad (2016), Game of Thrones and more. Kwame Patterson Kwame Patterson. Robin L Marshall/Getty While it isn’t clear who Kwame Patterson will be playing in Euphoria season 3, he made his excitement for the latest installment of the show clear. The actor shared an Instagram Reel announcing his name in the new cast lineup, writing, “Beyond grateful to join the Euphoria family.” “This opportunity means the world to me — a true dream and milestone,” Patterson continued. “Thank you @hbo for having me back #Thewire - once-in-a-lifetime monumental career moment.” The actor has previously appeared in The Wire, The Oath, The Outpost (2019) and more. Marshawn Lynch Marshawn Lynch. Courtesy of HBO Former Seattle Seahawks player Lynch has also joined Euphoria season 3 — and he's dedicated to doing the role justice. “Let’s just say I had fun in that motherf---er,” he told The New York Post in April 2026. “I was trying to hold my own [and] trying not to be the motherf---er that they’re waiting on to get your s--- together.” Lynch added, “I wanted them to take me seriously … but at the same time, I still am who I am. So, you get a lot of that [in the show].” This is far from the former NFL player’s first acting role — he’s also appeared in Brooklyn Nine-Nine, Westworld, Bottoms (2023) and more. Eli Roth Eli Roth. Monica Schipper/WireImage Eli Roth has joined the cast roster for the third installment of Euphoria, and it isn’t his first time working with Levinson. “It was amazing,” Roth previously told Deadline. “I had an incredible experience working with Sam Levinson on The Idol. He’s a friend and he called me, and he said, ‘I’ve got something for you,’ so of course I said yes.” The actor has also starred in Inglourious Bastards (2009) and Rock of Ages (2012). Sam Trammell Sam Trammell. Emma McIntyre/Getty True Blood alum Sam Trammell has also joined Euphoria’s extensive new cast lineup for season 3. Like most of his contemporaries, Trammell’s role is yet to be revealed — but the actor made his passion for the project clear. “So excited to be joining the exceptionally talented group of people on @euphoria, and the artistic vision of Sam Levinson,” Trammell wrote on Instagram in October 2025. In addition to True Blood, the actor has appeared in projects like The Fault in Our Stars (2014), This Is Us and Homeland. Trisha Paytas Trisha Paytas. Presley Ann/Getty Paytas, who rose to fame on YouTube, rounds out the new cast members of Euphoria season 3. In November 2025, Paytas told PEOPLE that filming the show was the "coolest experience ever." "I feel like such an actress," she added. "Sam Levinson was directing, and he was super cool because I love The Idol, and we talked so much off-camera about that." While Euphoria will be Paytas’ biggest TV role to date, she spent late 2025 acting in Beetlejuice on Broadway.
